doc: The vortex list build_flow draws for body fast_rotator_0.4d and seed 7 (38 vortices: cyclone, anticyclone pairs per hemisphere then Poisson(1.5) tropical storms), as arrays in vortex order (kind 0 cyclone, 1 anticyclone, 2 tropical; lon, lat, radius, omega, ascent, age) and the four flow scalars (hadley_deg, jet, trades, polar_easterlies). The numbers come from numpy default_rng(seed ^ 0x5F10): a port with another generator CANNOT reproduce lon, lat, radius, omega or age, so this case is tagged rng; it binds a port only through flow_scalars, the vortex count per kind and hemisphere and the sign of omega (see build_flow.structure.bodies and the stat cases) and it feeds the kernels real vortex lists. Python-vs-Python tolerance: float64 rtol 1e-9, kind exact.

params.tag_rng: a port with another random generator skips this case, except flow_scalars and the vortex count per kind and hemisphere (which equal build_flow.structure.bodies)
